hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Drink all full bottles first to accumulate empty bottles.

hints.title: Exchange Rule
hints.text: Each time empty bottles are converted into one full bottle, the required exchange threshold increments by one.

hints.title: Loop Invariant
hints.text: While empty bottles count is at least the exchange threshold, subtract threshold, increment threshold, drink the new bottle, and add one empty bottle.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def maxBottlesDrunk(self, numBottles: int, numExchange: int) -> int:
        ans = numBottles
        empty = numBottles
        while empty >= numExchange:
            empty -= numExchange
            numExchange += 1
            ans += 1
            empty += 1
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Exchange cost increases linearly by one on every round.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Assuming constant exchange cost yields incorrect counts.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Track mutating exchange costs accurately during simulation.
